name: Kimibeta ~Kimi o Betabeta ni Sasete Ageru~
original_name: キミベタ～キミをベタベタにさせてあげる～
source:
One day, Shingo gets involved in a traffic accident and is taken to the hospital. It is not a serious injury, so he leaves there soon. On his first day at school after the accident, Kyoko, his classroom teacher, suddenly sexually assaults him after school. Since then, she often sexually teases him at school. He is also sexually assaulted by Satsuki, a sick-room teacher, and Tsukasa, a PE teacher. What's going on at school...? What will happen to Shingo...?

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090413062356/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012266]ErogeShop.com[/url]]
translation:
某天，慎吾遭遇了一场交通事故并被送往医院，所幸伤势并无大碍，很快便得以出院。然而伤愈返校的第一天放学后，班主任恭子竟突然对他动手动脚、强行侵犯；自那以后，她在学校里也频频对他百般挑逗。不仅如此，保健室老师皋月与体育老师司也接连向他伸出魔爪。这所学校里究竟发生了什么……？慎吾又将迎来怎样的命运……？
